titre: L'offre de commerces neufs a disparu
sous_titre: Livraisons trimestrielles de surfaces commerciales neuves aux États-Unis, en millions de pieds carrés

T4 2015.texte: It was down from a peak of more than 25M SF in Q4 2015.

T4 2025.texte: New deliveries fell to 5 million sq. ft., partly due to elevated construction costs.

T1 2026.texte: US retail construction completions fell to 4.7M SF in Q1 2026, marking the lowest quarterly delivery volume in two decades.

T2 2026.texte: Retail construction completions fell to 5.7 million square feet in the second quarter, setting record lows.
